i.norm: When two tags are requested with different raw tag names but the SAME normal name, {@link TagSet#valueOf} resolves the second request back to the Tag already cached under that shared normal name (case is not preserved, so lookup happens by normal name). The two calls therefore return the very same Tag instance.
A shared normal name used for two different raw tag names.
First lookup creates and caches a new Tag keyed by the shared normal name.
Second lookup uses a different raw name but the same normal name, so it resolves to the already-cached Tag instead of creating a new one.
